user.title: Mitsubishi AE-200 / EW-50
user.description: Enter the IP address of your AE-200, AE-50, EW-50 or compatible centralised controller. The controller must be reachable on your network.

data.prefer_websocket: Prefer websocket (gives zone names; recommended for AE-200/EW-50)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check the IP address and that the controller's web interface is reachable.
error.no_groups: Connected, but no air-conditioning groups were found on the controller.

set_local_restrictions.name: Set local remote restrictions
set_local_restrictions.description: Change selected functions on one group's local remote. Requires current data from a supported air-conditioning group. Supply at least one restriction; omitted functions keep their effective settings. Returns this transaction's report; an acknowledgement alone is not confirmation by readback.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to change. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: One configured group number from 1 to 50 on the selected controller.

power_prohibited.name: Prohibit local power control
power_prohibited.description: True prohibits on/off changes on the local remote; false permits them. Omit to keep its effective setting.

mode_prohibited.name: Prohibit local mode control
mode_prohibited.description: True prohibits operating mode changes on the local remote; false permits them. Omit to keep its effective setting.

temperature_prohibited.name: Prohibit local temperature control
temperature_prohibited.description: True prohibits set temperature changes on the local remote; false permits them. Omit to keep its effective setting.

filter_reset_prohibited.name: Prohibit local filter reset
filter_reset_prohibited.description: True prohibits filter reminder reset on the local remote; false permits it. Omit to keep its effective setting. This does not reset the reminder itself.

read_weekly_pattern.name: Read weekly pattern
read_weekly_pattern.description: Read one group's weekly pattern for an explicit season and pattern number. Returns a snapshot without enabling it or assigning a weekday. Reads share a minimum 15 second interval.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: One configured group number from 1 to 50 on the selected controller.

season.name: Season number
season.description: One controller season number from 1 to 5. Its calendar assignment is not inferred.

pattern.name: Pattern number
pattern.description: One weekly pattern number from 1 to 7. This number is not treated as a weekday.

read_controller_clock.name: Read controller clock
read_controller_clock.description: Read the controller's local wall clock on demand. Returns a snapshot with its own data quality and no inferred time zone. Reads share a minimum 15 second interval.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

read_today_schedule.name: Read today's schedule
read_today_schedule.description: Read today's controller schedule for one configured group on demand. Returns a snapshot, including an empty schedule, without predicting the next execution. Reads share a minimum 15 second interval.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: One configured group number from 1 to 50 on the selected controller.

read_control_context.name: Read control context
read_control_context.description: Read the controller and selected group's stop context on demand without changing settings. Each part reports its own data quality. Reads share a minimum 15 second interval.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: One configured group number from 1 to 50 on the selected controller.

read_member.name: Read indoor unit member
read_member.description: Read one indoor unit address verified by this controller's cached topology and return its diagnostic sample. Member reads share a minimum 15 second interval and are never polled automatically.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

address.name: Member address
address.description: One indoor unit bus address from 1 to 250, verified by the cached controller topology. This is not a group number or an IP address.
